description: Average over all order items. Those with no invoice line items contribute a count of zero and no ratio.

c.request: Per order item, work out the average of `derived_product_cost` ÷ `derived_total_cost` over its invoice line items (skipping missing ratios) and how many invoice line items it has. In a single row, what are the overall average of those per-item ratios (ignoring missing ones) and the average number of invoice line items per order item? Average over all order items. Those with no invoice line items contribute a count of zero and no ratio.
c.sql: WITH per_item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Order_Items AS oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS overall_average_ratio, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_items_per_order_item FROM per_item;

d.request: For each order item, count its invoice line items and average `derived_product_cost / derived_total_cost` across line items with nonmissing ratios; then return one row containing the average of the available per-item ratios and the average line-item count across all order items, including zero counts for items with no invoice line items.
d.sql: WITH per_item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, COUNT(ili.invoice_number) AS line_item_count, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Order_Items AS oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_per_item_ratio, AVG(line_item_count) AS avg_line_item_count FROM per_item;

a.request: For every order item in `Order_Items`, including those with no invoice line items (which count as zero line items), take the average of `derived_product_cost` divided by `derived_total_cost` across its invoice line items (skipping missing ratios), and count its invoice line items. Then return one row with the average of those per-item average ratios (ignoring missing ones) and the average of those per-item line-item counts.
a.sql: WITH per_item AS (SELECT oi.order_item_id, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(ili.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS average_ratio, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count FROM Order_Items AS oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS average_item_ratio, AVG(line_item_count) AS average_line_item_count FROM per_item

b.request: For each order item, count its invoice line items and average the nonmissing `derived_product_cost` ÷ `derived_total_cost` ratios; return one row with the average of those per-item ratios where defined and the average invoice line item count across all order items, including zero counts.
b.sql: SELECT AVG(item_avg_ratio) AS average_item_ratio, AVG(line_item_count * 1.0) AS average_invoice_line_item_count FROM (SELECT oi.order_item_id, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) AS line_item_count, AVG(CASE WHEN ili.derived_total_cost <> 0 THEN ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost END) AS item_avg_ratio FROM Order_Items AS oi LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items AS ili ON ili.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id GROUP BY oi.order_item_id) AS per_item;
b.raw: For each order item, count its invoice line items and average the nonmissing `derived_product_cost` ÷ `derived_total_cost` ratios; return one row with the average of those per-item ratios where defined and the average invoice line item count across all order items, including zero counts.
